title: First Drive: 2027 BMW iX5 Offers Extended Range
excerpt: BMW's upcoming 2027 iX5 electric vehicle features an impressive range of over 450 miles and automated self-closing doors.
body_html:
BMW has showcased its upcoming electric vehicle, the 2027 iX5, highlighting its notable driving range and unique features. During a first drive evaluation, reviewers noted that the new EV is capable of traveling over 450 miles on a single charge.

Along with its extended battery range, the vehicle introduces automated functionality, including doors that close on their own. While the vehicle's performance and capabilities stand out, early impressions suggest that its exterior styling may provoke mixed reactions among buyers.
